title: Log Log Fluctuations of the Stochastic Heat Flow
summary: We study the stochastic heat flow with constant initial data and analyze its spatial average on the scale of $\varepsilon\ll1$. We prove that the logarithm of the averaged process satisfies a pointwise central limit theorem: After being centered by $-\tfrac{1}{2}\log\log \varepsilon^{-1}$ and scaled down by $\sqrt{\log\log \varepsilon^{-1}}$, it converges in distribution to a standard Gaussian.
